request.purpose: We want to reduce sick leave. We will use the results to decide whose fixed-term contracts we do not renew.
request.question: How many patients were newly diagnosed with type 2 diabetes in 2024, by sex?
definitions: New type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11 and an onset_date in 2024.
Report per sex: patients with new type 2 diabetes.
